description.html: HabiStat Crested Gecko Diet Mango is a high-quality, complete food for crested geckos (Correlophus ciliatus) and similar gecko species that eat a combination of fruit and insects in the wild. This product has a high real-fruit content - mango powder makes up over 50% of the total formula, giving it a rich tropical flavor that geckos readily accept. Besides fruit, the formula contains 9 different animal protein sources that provide all the essential amino acids needed for healthy growth, development and maintaining body weight.

With 23% protein and 1.95% calcium, this food provides an optimal nutritional balance. The calcium-to-phosphorus ratio is 3.87:1, which is extremely important for proper bone mineralization and preventing metabolic bone disease in geckos. The product is completely natural - it contains no artificial colors, flavors or preservatives, which makes it safe for everyday use.

To prepare a meal, mix about 5g of powder with water until it reaches a ketchup-like thickness. Serve the food in a shallow dish inside the terrarium, ideally in the evening when geckos are most active. Feeding 1 to 2 times a week is recommended, and uneaten food should be removed after 24 hours. HabiStat is a respected British brand that has been making specialized reptile equipment and food for decades.

All equipment can be ordered by phone or WhatsApp message. Courier delivery across Serbia, in-person pickup in Novi Sad. For questions about the product, compatibility or recommendations for your animal - get in touch.
